body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-scripts-ci finding 2). scripts/test/env-hermeticity-guard.test.mjs is 1,651 lines of code containing a 30-function Acorn AST dataflow parser and 55 redundant parser unit tests. Its own documentation notes that scripts/run-tests.mjs already scrubs sensitive ambient environment variables (ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY, RAILS_BASE, BASE_REF, etc.) prior to running any test segment, making this guard a non-load-bearing drift backstop rather than a load-bearing compiler.

Replace the 1,651-line Acorn AST parser in scripts/test/env-hermeticity-guard.test.mjs with a concise, lightweight check (~60-80 lines) that:
1. Scans candidate test files in packages/*/test/*.test.mjs and scripts/test/*.test.mjs.
2. Identifies spawn calls to ADLC entrypoints (rails-guard-ci.mjs, rails-guard.mjs, bin/adlc-*.mjs).
3. Verifies that ambient environment spreads (...process.env) either:
   (a) neutralize the sensitive variables (e.g., ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY: '' or RAILS_BASE: '' or module-level pin), or
   (b) carry a nearby suppression comment (// env-hermeticity: inherits ...).
4. Verifies 0 violations across current HEAD.
5. Verifies that a planted un-neutralized spawn fails, while a neutralized or suppressed spawn passes.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
- AC1 scripts/test/env-hermeticity-guard.test.mjs is reduced by at least 1,400 lines (under 200 lines total).
- AC2 node --test scripts/test/env-hermeticity-guard.test.mjs exits 0 (all tests pass).
- AC3 The guard detects a planted violation without neutralization or suppression.
- AC4 scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs remains untouched (rail-freeze clean).
- AC5 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(scripts): replace heavyweight env-hermeticity parser with lightweight scanner
